name: ledge
description: A shelf for your screenshots along the top of the screen. Out of the way until you reach for it.
author: Himanshu <himanshugupta.dev@gmail.com>

scripts.build: npm run build:main && npm run build:renderer
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.web.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.dist:mas: npm run build && electron-builder --mac mas --publish never

extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: Ledge watches your screenshot folder so new screenshots appear on the ledge.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: Ledge watches your screenshot folder so new screenshots appear on the ledge.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: Ledge watches your screenshot folder so new screenshots appear on the ledge.
